summary.text: STIFTELSEN PROSJEKT GATEBARN I KENYA is a foundation registered in Langesund, founded 2001-01-02. Stiftelsen Prosjekt Gatebarn i Kenya samler inn og forvalter penger som går til drift av en skole for foreldreløse og gatebarn i Kenya. Organisasjonen gir barn og unge skolegang og utdannelse gjennom en fadderordning og arbeider for bedre levekår for fattige og foreldreløse barn. Its main industry code is 94.991: activities of charities which distribute means themselves. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 5 831 147 NOK and the annual result was 1 532 912 NOK; operating income was up from 4 813 503 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 497 140 NOK in 2024 to 1 532 912 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 3 243 026 NOK in 2024 to 4 775 938 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is prosjektgatebarn.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The latest news on its own website is "Jan's Academy ror for Norge" from 2026-07-16. Recent changes in the register: business address set to Storgata 8 on 2026-09-17.
